It is also called '''Kisami Hachiman Shrine''' (きさみはちまんじんじゃ), taking its name from the locality.

=== Overview ===
The shrine is enshrined on the west side of the road that heads south from {{ill|Japan National Route 136|Q11421406|qid=Q11421406}} toward Kisami Ohama Beach.

It is a candidate shrine (ronsha) for '''Kamiminomikoto Shrine''' (かみのみことじんじゃ), which is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}. The Mishima Shrine enshrined together as an auxiliary shrine was merged in {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 11 ({{ill|1879|Q7783|qid=Q7783}}) and is considered to correspond to one of the three seats of '''Takama (Tsukumano) Shrine''' (たかま(つくまの)じんじゃ), a Shikinaisha, whose enshrined deity is Awa-me no Mikoto, the principal consort of Mishima Daimyōjin. Furthermore, the Wakamiya subsidiary shrine within the precincts is a candidate shrine for '''Takemikakanomikoto Shrine''' (たけみかかのみことじんじゃ), also a Shikinaisha<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/hatiman_title.htm Hachiman Shrine] - Genmatsuko</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140142-02.html Hachiman Shrine] - Research on Engishiki Shrines</ref>.
